description: This file defines test classes for DNS configuration service, including a basic test implementation and a specialized test class for reading hosts with simulated change notifications.

classes.name: TestDnsConfigService
classes.description: A simple test implementation of DnsConfigService that triggers notifications via explicit method calls.

classes.name: HostsReadingTestDnsConfigService
classes.description: A test class that exercises the HostsReader and simulates host change notifications.

classes.name: HostsReader
classes.description: Inner class responsible for creating work items for reading hosts, using a provided parser factory.

classes.name: Watcher
classes.description: Inner class that simulates watching for host file changes and triggers notifications.

methods.name: ReadConfigNow
methods.description: Overrides to simulate reading DNS config immediately.

methods.name: ReadHostsNow
methods.description: Overrides to simulate reading DNS hosts immediately.

methods.name: StartWatching
methods.description: Starts watching for DNS configuration changes.

methods.name: CreateWorkItem
methods.description: Creates a work item for reading hosts.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Starts watching for host file changes.
